intro: What each thing you sell really costs you, and what you keep from its price.
hidden: Your role doesn't show costs or margins. You can see names and prices.

how.title: How your costs are worked out
how.materials: Materials: the average of what you paid for them from {{from}} to {{to}}, or your last purchase.
how.askOwner: Ask the owner to set it in Settings.
how.noTime_one: {{count}} product has none of your time yet: add the minutes it takes you on the product.
how.noTime_other: {{count}} products have none of your time yet: add the minutes each takes you on the product.

rate.byPrice: Your running costs and expenses (rent, salaries, bills…) are shared over everything you sell by its price: each thing you sell carries the same percentage of its price.
rate.example: For example, if a month's costs are {{costs}} and its sales {{sales}}, that's {{costsNumber}} ÷ {{salesNumber}} = {{percent}}: something priced {{price}} carries {{share}}, and something priced {{small}} carries {{smallShare}}.
rate.awaiting: Worked out automatically once you record your sales. Until then, your costs and margins are before running costs.
rate.short: Running costs: worked out automatically once you record your sales.
rate.not_entered: Enter your running costs (rent, salaries…): they're what is shared over what you sell.
rate.applied: This month, each thing you sell carries {{percent}} of its price: your costs {{costs}} ÷ your sales {{sales}} in {{month}}.
rate.appliedRate: This month, each thing you sell carries {{percent}} of its price ({{month}}).
rate.soFar: This month, each thing you sell carries {{percent}} of its price: your costs {{costs}} ÷ your sales {{sales}} so far, from your first sale on {{day}}.
rate.soFarRate: This month, each thing you sell carries {{percent}} of its price: so far, from your first sale on {{day}}.
rate.none: Your running costs come to zero, so nothing is shared.
rate.before: Your first sales are in. The percentage shows on {{day}}, once you have 7 days of sales. Until then, your costs and margins are before running costs.
rate.shortSoFar: Running costs: {{percent}} of each price (so far this month).
rate.shortBefore: Running costs: shown from {{day}}, once you have 7 days of sales.

pool.title: Your business's costs in {{month}}
pool.shared: This is what will be shared over what you sold in {{month}} once your sales are recorded.
pool.billsInstead: From its bills, in place of its regular {{regular}}

period.quarter: Its bills for the quarter from {{from}} to {{to}} ({{bills}}), spread over its 3 months
period.quarterInstead: Its bills for the quarter from {{from}} to {{to}} ({{bills}}), spread over its 3 months, in place of its regular {{regular}}
period.year: Its bills for the year from {{from}} to {{to}} ({{bills}}), spread over its 12 months
period.yearInstead: Its bills for the year from {{from}} to {{to}} ({{bills}}), spread over its 12 months, in place of its regular {{regular}}

pool.extra: Extra expenses, on top of its running costs
pool.takenBackOnly: An earlier month's bill, reversed in this month
pool.takenBack: Less {{amount}}: an earlier month's bill, reversed in this month
pool.note: Each running cost counts once: its own bills for the month, or else its regular amount. Extra expenses count on top, and the bills of a running cost paid by the quarter or the year are spread over its months.
pool.noPurchases: Material purchases aren't here: they're in each item's materials.
pool.noPurchasesUsed: Materials your products use aren't here: they're in each item's own cost.
pool.vat: Amounts are before VAT: VAT you get back isn't a cost.
pool.none: Nothing counted for {{month}}: no running costs and no final expenses for that month.
pool.hidden: Your business's costs in {{month}} show only to those who can see running costs and expenses.
pool.sharedApplied: Shared over your sales of {{sales}} in {{month}}: {{percent}} of each price.
pool.sharedAppliedRate: Shared over what you sold in {{month}}: {{percent}} of each price.
pool.sharedDays: Shared over your sales of {{sales}} in those days: {{percent}} of each price.
pool.sharedDaysRate: Shared over what you sold in those days: {{percent}} of each price.
pool.sharedNone: They come to zero, so nothing is shared.
pool.sharedBefore: Shared over what you sell once you have 7 days of sales, on {{day}}.
pool.materialsNote: Materials that nothing you sell uses count here, in the month they were bought. Add them to a recipe to make them that item's own cost.
